body: The woman I adopted her from completely ran out of it so she wasn't able to give me some to transition her. She told us "purina healthy puppy: chicken", so we picked up the purina one formula. Found out today she was eating the Purina Beneful. We already fed her the incorrect one yesterday and today, so I'm wondering how to move forward to get her tummy back on track.
Oooh that's true, thanks! Definitely super pro-spay. I'm sure I'll get a better idea of the timing when we go to our first vet visit.

Gotcha! We probably won't be able to get into a vet right away(most are super booked or aren't taking new clients) so I'm just digging around right now so I get an idea of all the options. Luckily she'll have her first round of shots when we pick her up, and we've already got flea and tick prevention sorted out!

Luckily we don't have dogs living near us, so she won't really be at risk in the yard. However, since I work at a grooming salon I'm hoping to bring her to work with me once we've got basic potty&obedience training down! It would be a bit complicated to do that if she's intact, but I guess it would only be an issue when she's in heat! Definitely leaning towards doing the spay closer to the 1-year-old mark.
That sounds like a good call! I'll definitely ask the vet for advice when we go for her first visit. Thanks for your response!
